note: Settlement reference = last <=16:00 ET 1-minute SPY bar close from backtest/data/spy_sip_cache (real SIP data, 664 trading dates on disk). A symbol/date with no cache file is a COVERAGE GAP, reported separately -- never silently assumed OTM. Standard OCC equity-option settlement rule: closing price, not a special AM value (that convention is index-option-only, e.g. SPX, and does not apply to SPY).
